h: Wanted Nigerian man reportedly arrested at a US airport after seven years on the run over a fraud scheme
p: A Nigerian man wanted over an alleged fraud scheme was reportedly arrested at a US airport after about seven years as a fugitive. He is said to have been charged in connection with the case.
more: Court dates have not been announced.
The case adds to a string of US-Nigeria cybercrime arrests this week.
